fiscality_sales_tax_zero_hint: Set 0 if you do not charge tax.
fiscality_vat_zero_hint: Set 0 if you do not charge VAT.
rounding_hint_daily: Each tracked time is rounded to the chosen step before being valued in days. With 0.5 d, 3 h tracked count as half a day and 5 h count as a full day; with 0.25 d, precision moves to the quarter-day. With minutes, time is valued exactly, without rounding.
rounding_hint_hourly: Each tracked time is rounded to the chosen step before being valued in hours. With 15 min, 1 h 07 tracked counts as 1 h 15; with 30 min, it counts as 1 h 30. With minutes, time is valued exactly, without rounding.
settings_acre_label: I benefit from the ACRE — the rate is reduced for the first four quarters.
settings_auto_entrepreneur_hint: The only status handled for now. Companies will come later.
settings_billing_description: Defaults offered when creating a client, and the threshold the Treasury page uses.
settings_buffer_hint: Amount kept in the business account before any transfer to your personal account.
settings_buffer_invalid: Enter an amount, or leave it empty.
settings_contribution_rate_hint: BNC service-provider rate, read from the URSSAF.
settings_country_note_abroad: Time tracking, clients and invoices work normally. This country's tax rules are not implemented yet though: contributions, VAT and the registration number must be entered by hand.
settings_country_note_france: France is the only country whose tax rules are implemented: the auto-entrepreneur regime, SIRET, URSSAF contributions and French VAT.
settings_currency_hint: Every amount in the app is counted and displayed in this currency: revenue, invoices, treasury buffer, provisions. It becomes final with the first priced mission or invoice.
settings_currency_locked: Locked: a priced mission or an invoice already exists in this currency.
settings_default_rate_description: Rate applied by default to new invoices.
settings_fiscality_abroad_description: URSSAF contributions, the franchise en base and the versement libératoire are specific to the French regime. The chosen country's rules are not implemented yet: provisions and filings must be computed outside the app.
settings_fiscality_description: These values drive the provisions and deadlines the app computes.
settings_fix_invalid_tab: Fix the invalid field in the {tab} tab.
settings_home_address_hint: Used for URSSAF and tax paperwork, never printed on CRAs or invoices.
settings_home_same_note: Your home address is the company's.
settings_identity_description: Make up the header of your CRAs and invoices.
settings_invoice_number_counter_error: The format must contain exactly one NNN counter.
settings_language_hint: Sets the interface language and the format of amounts and numbers. CRA documents stay in French.
settings_liberating_payment_hint: Adds {rate} % to the contributions and removes the annual income tax.
settings_load_failed: The settings could not be loaded.
settings_made_at_note: “Fait à {city}” will appear on signed documents.
settings_page_subtitle: Company identity, signature and the tax setup of your micro-entreprise.
settings_payment_terms_hint: Beyond 60 days, keep the statutory late-payment penalties in mind.
settings_provisioned_rate_hint: Social contributions only. Income tax remains due annually.
settings_rates_failed: The URSSAF scale could not be read. Your current rates are unchanged.
settings_rates_source_hint: Opusline reads the scales published by the URSSAF and applies the current rate.
settings_rates_unsaved: Save to apply the scale to this situation.
settings_regional_description: Country of business, the currency Opusline counts your activity in, and the interface language.
settings_save_failed: The save failed. Try again in a moment.
settings_signature_description: Sign once — with the mouse, the trackpad or the keyboard by typing your name. Opusline applies it to every generated CRA and invoice.
settings_signature_failed: The upload failed. Try again in a moment.
settings_timezone_hint: Sets today's date for payments, CRA sends and invoices — a payment entered at 0:30 lands on your date, not the server's.
settings_workday_hint: Converts tracked time into day fractions on TJM missions. The change also applies to history already tracked.
vat_regime_franchise_note: Your invoices carry the notice “TVA non applicable, art. 293 B du CGI”.
vat_regime_normal_note: Your invoices carry VAT and a CA3 return is expected every month.
vat_regime_simplified_note: Your invoices carry VAT and a CA12 return is expected every year, with instalments.
